# shadowed-lambda.kt: outer `total` is written once on line 3; the line-26 write targets the inner `run` block's own `total` under the forEach lambda parameter, so misattribution would span 23 and fire.
# anon-param.kt: the `x` on line 18 binds the anonymous function's bare-name parameter, not the outer `var x` written on lines 2-3; if the param were dropped from function_params, misattribution would span 16 and fire.
